bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
pg="$(docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -Ei 'postgres' || true)"
test "$(printf '%s\n' "$pg" | sed '/^$/d' | wc -l)" -eq 1 || exit 61
docker exec "$pg" sh -c 'psql -X -q -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d gaybbs -At -F "|" -c "
SELECT chat_id,message_thread_id,state,COALESCE(message_id,0),pinned FROM topic_dm_entry_pins
WHERE chat_id IN (-1002373696859,-1003770334893,-1003847210571)
AND message_thread_id IN (1379,44,273,105,995,994,993,992,991,990,621,999,998,997,996,1723,1724,4291,4672,783,18,1) ORDER BY chat_id,message_thread_id;
"'
echo NORMAL_CANDIDATE_DB_PIN_READ_COMPLETE
